entries.text: The BigQuery adapter now requests `safe_division` from the bundled SQLGlot runtime through `apply_rewrite` instead of its own division rewrite. A zero divisor still yields NULL. Nested divisions (`a / (b / c)`, TPC-DS Q58 and Q83) are now rewritten at every level, so a zero inner divisor yields NULL instead of an error. Queries are no longer emitted with every identifier quoted.
